event_name: Aston Martin Red Bull Racing Document 54 Date 28 July 2019 Time 18:46 2019 GERMAN GRAND PRIX 25 - 28 July 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Alleged breach of the FIA International Sporting Code Appendix L Chapter IV Article 2(d).
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video evidence and determined that the driver Gasly made an error while attempting to pass Albon after Turn 6. As no other car was disadvantaged except Gasly, the Stewards determined to take no further action.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 10 Incident With Car 23 After Turn 6
